How to play

Click a piece, then one of its highlighted legal squares. Protect your king and checkmate your opponent.

Drag the board to orbit. Scroll or use + / − to zoom. The lightbulb suggests a move. Undo takes back your last turn.

Castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate, and draws are supported. Games save automatically in this browser.

Take your time. Make your move.
